fabricatedOrForbiddenMeaning.description: Triggering observation content ('Observed failure under investigation', 'Source: recorded system observation') and a generic 'Evidence record' are presented without any supplied observation or evidence predicate. They are generic placeholders, but they assert a source/provenance the state does not provide.

Borderline: the 'LOCAL' badge in the Persistence card may read as asserting local-only persistence, which the state does not supply. The accompanying text ('Remote persistence not established. No remote success is inferred...') does frame it as unknown rather than as a known fact.

evidenceLimitations: The desktop page fits in one viewport, so the navigation probe shows focus moving to the Unresolved unknowns section with no scroll change. No visible focus ring is discernible in probe-001.viewport.png. Operability at non-desktop viewports (where the blocker sits above Actions on phone) was not probed. The disabled button has no aria-describedby link to its reason text.
